html:
The Captains Regent are the two joint heads of state of San Marino. Since at least 1243 the republic has elected two of them every six months.

The system was meant to stop any one family from seizing power, as happened in most Italian city republics. Each captain can block the other, and neither can serve again for three years. The Grand and General Council elects them, and they take office every 1 April and 1 October in an old ceremony.

Their rules are set out in the statutes of 1600. It is one of the oldest forms of government still in use, a living piece of the medieval Italian commune. See San Marino.
sum: The Captains Regent are the two joint heads of state of San Marino. Since at least 1243 the republic has elected two of them every six months.
